pages.title: Octonion Crystal
pages.text: Eight-dimensional numbers, built by doubling quaternions once more. Multiplication stops even associating, so the order you group products in matters. Yet every non-zero octonion still has an inverse; they are the last and largest normed division algebra. The crystal is beautiful and slightly unsettling to look at for long.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Doubling the quaternions by the Cayley-Dickson trick needed room for eight dimensions, which a Calabi-Yau manifold and some exotic matter provided. A prime shard stabilised the multiplication table. Hurwitz says there is nothing beyond this that still divides.
